identity.title: Move Image Compare display-coordinate policy out of the Window Partial

origin.summary: The user requested that the Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that remaining Partial responsibilities be structurally corrected.

state.current_summary: ImageCompareWindow의 표시 좌표 매핑 계산을 기존 ImageCompareViewModel의 순수 정책으로 이동했다. Window는 WPF event 측정값 전달과 기존 status 호출만 유지하며, XAML/public binding/resource lifetime은 보존했다. Debug/Release focused contract와 Smoke build가 통과했다. 전체 WPF visual/hardware/native 행렬은 미검증으로 남겼다.

objective.summary: Move the Image Compare display-to-pixel coordinate mapping policy from the required XAML Window Partial to the existing ImageCompareViewModel without changing pointer behavior, status bindings, or image resource ownership.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Keep ImageCompareWindow as the required XAML Window Partial and do not add a new service, interface, wrapper, registry, or Partial.
Preserve existing ImageCompareWindow events, ImageCompareViewModel status properties, ImageCompareSlotViewModel resource lifetime, and public LoadImages facade.
Keep all test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or change the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records the current and intended owner, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public contract, and matching test.

ImageCompareWindow no longer contains the coordinate-mapping algorithm; ImageCompareViewModel owns a WPF-object-free policy that preserves center, letterbox rejection, edge clamp, and invalid-dimension behavior.
Focused Debug/Release contracts, relevant Debug/Release builds, and targeted diff checks pass, with full WPF runtime and native qualification explicitly unverified.

milestones.summary: Freeze the Image Compare Partial caller, owner, binding, and lifetime contract.
Move pure display-coordinate mapping to ImageCompareViewModel and keep the Window as a WPF adapter.
Run focused Debug/Release proof and record durable evidence.

evidence.observation: The Window no longer contains TryMapImagePoint or the scale/letterbox algorithm; it delegates a numeric snapshot to the existing ViewModel owner while preserving the existing status update path and XAML contracts.
ImageComparePointMappingContract passed 4/4 in Debug and Release for centered mapping, letterbox rejection, edge clamp, and invalid dimensions.
VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors, both focused contract runs passed, and targeted git diff --check passed.

events.summary: ImageCompareWindow의 XAML/input/lifetime 경계는 유지하고, WPF 객체가 필요 없는 display-to-pixel 계산만 기존 ImageCompareViewModel로 이동한다. 새 추상화나 Partial은 추가하지 않는다.
PL-0032의 세 completion criteria와 세 milestone이 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 WPF/native runtime 검증은 별도 범위로 남긴다.
PL-0032의 owner proof, 최소 구조 이동, focused Debug/Release 검증이 완료되어 resolved로 닫는다. 동일 owner는 새 defect, requirement, failed criterion 또는 dependency boundary 전에는 다시 열지 않는다.
